_doc: Architectural contracts. Skills depend on contracts, never directly on another skill's internals. layer: 0 platform, 1 foundation, 2 engine services, 3 subsystems, 4 game framework, 5 tools; 'P' = process contract (not code). 'requires' = build-level interface dependencies; must be acyclic and point to the same or a lower layer. 'universal': 'runtime' = implicitly consumed by every runtime skill; 'all' = implicitly consumed by every skill.

contracts.name: Platform abstraction layer
contracts.summary: OS services, CPU/GPU capability discovery and device database, windowing, display & safe area, lifecycle and system events (memory pressure, thermal/power, network reachability, audio endpoint, locale, OS accessibility settings, overlay/focus, storage, page size), clocks and clock-domain correlation, processes/pipes/shared memory/dev sockets, HTTP(S)/TLS client, permissions, thread creation/affinity/QoS and main-thread dispatch. Platform code lives only in the PAL or in a registered platform backend slot; suspend/resume quiesce protocol (outstanding IO, GPU idle/device recreate, connection loss) and time-discontinuity events; interfaces and policy owned by platform-architect; each platform's implementation is a registered backend implemented by that platform's skill; key chain: device record → GPU feature tier (C-GPUTIER) + platform capability tier → performance tier → knob set (C-SCALE).

contracts.name: Error & failure model
contracts.summary: Result types, assertion tiers, fatal vs recoverable, degradation rules.

contracts.name: Module & lifecycle
contracts.summary: Module descriptors, serial bootstrap then parallel init dependency graph, service registration, shutdown order, declarative self-registration (no central tables).

contracts.name: Configuration & cvars
contracts.summary: Layered config sources (defaults, platform, device profile, remote/live, user) with precedence, typed cvars read through versioned immutable snapshots latched at sync points, queued change notification; per-layer trust tier and per-cvar settable-from allow-list; settings are declared as scoped C-CFG entries (device/user/cloud); the user layer is a read-only projection populated by the persisted settings store (GAM.SAVE.settings); the remote/live layer is a sink of the single C-LIVE remote-config payload.

contracts.name: Math & numeric conventions
contracts.summary: Vector/matrix types, precision classes, deterministic-math variants, fixed and scalable (vector-length-agnostic) SIMD kernels, convention enforcement.

contracts.name: Allocation & memory accounting
contracts.summary: Allocator interface, tagging, budgets hooks, OOM behavior.

contracts.name: Core types & containers
contracts.summary: Containers, strings, versioned stable hashing, general-purpose compression codecs, hashing, ownership/view types.

contracts.name: Concurrency primitives & thread-safety annotations
contracts.summary: Atomics, locks, lock-free queues, safe reclamation, thread-safety annotation conventions, OS-waitable completion tokens that IO/GPU fences plug into.

contracts.name: Task graph & job API
contracts.summary: Task creation, dependencies, priorities/QoS, blocking rules, completion-token integration, process-wide thread inventory with pinned/affinity lanes and middleware adapters, serial deterministic test mode and schedule-perturbation hooks, task tracing.

contracts.name: Instrumentation
contracts.summary: Log/trace/metric API; zero cost when compiled out; trace format; declared overhead per zone/counter class, overhead budget in C-BUDGET.

contracts.name: Crash & diagnostic hooks
contracts.summary: Crash context annotations, breadcrumbs, watchdog registration.

contracts.name: Determinism
contracts.summary: Determinism levels, floating-point rules, ordered-execution rules, state-hash hooks.

contracts.name: Budgets & performance gates
contracts.summary: Budget numbers per hardware tier × configuration × refresh class, derived from the performance model; perf gate thresholds; transfer bytes per frame and async-queue occupancy per tier.

contracts.name: Plugin descriptor & loading
contracts.summary: Plugin manifest, dependency resolution, load phases, ABI tags.

contracts.name: Frame schedule, phases & time
contracts.summary: Time domains and multi-rate cadences, pipelining depth, the minimal set of named global sync points, frame-wide access declarations (ECS components and registered service resources) from which ordering is derived, the canonical simulation schedule, injectable test clock.

contracts.name: Identity & references
contracts.summary: Entity IDs, GUIDs, reference kinds, lifetime rules, events.

contracts.name: ECS
contracts.summary: Components, queries, systems, access declarations, command buffers.

contracts.name: Reflection & type metadata
contracts.summary: Type registry, properties, attributes, dynamic invocation.

contracts.name: Serialization & schema evolution
contracts.summary: Formats, versioning, upgraders, canonical form, untrusted-input rules.

contracts.name: Async IO
contracts.summary: IO requests, priorities, deadlines, completions, decompression targets; GPU decompression is declared as external work items executed as render-graph nodes where no dedicated decompression queue exists.

contracts.name: Package & VFS mounts
contracts.summary: Package format, mount layering (base, patch, DLC, mods, remote), chunk IDs, integrity; codec per target constrained by available hardware decompressors.

contracts.name: Asset identity & references
contracts.summary: Asset IDs, soft/hard references, dependency declaration, registry queries.

contracts.name: Resource lifetime & streaming requests
contracts.summary: Resource handles and explicit lifetime; load requests with priority/deadline; the staged load pipeline (IO → decompress → fixup → GPU upload → publish) that every resource type implements; pool registration, pressure signals and shrink-by-deadline requests; residency notifications drained at a declared C-FRAME phase; fallbacks; every CPU/GPU pool registers with the arbiter and never sizes itself.

contracts.name: Hot reload
contracts.summary: Change notifications, invalidation, state preservation hooks.

contracts.name: Transforms & spatial queries
contracts.summary: Transform representation incl. large-world coordinates, hierarchy, generic spatial queries, per-phase change sets (moved/attached/teleported) consumed by all spatial replicas; batched query API.

contracts.name: Render hardware interface
contracts.summary: Devices, queues and command recording, completion tokens, binding-model tier (bindless / descriptor-buffer / bind-group), pipeline-state-model tier (monolithic PSO / libraries / shader objects / state-object programs), GPU-generated work primitives, presentation, implicit-sync backends; the RHI consumes C-PRESENT to report present feedback; shipping-grade GPU timestamp signal for the governor; optional tensor/matrix resource types and weight-layout conversion tier (reviewed by ml-inference-runtime before freeze).

contracts.name: GPU resources & memory
contracts.summary: Resource creation, heaps, residency, upload/readback, lifetime; residency obeys arbiter pressure/shrink requests delivered through the C-RES pool registration hook.

contracts.name: ML inference
contracts.summary: Model format and packaging, CPU and NPU backends, async invocation, precision classes, budgets; sequence sessions, streaming results, residency class, local/remote routing.

contracts.name: World partition & streaming cells
contracts.summary: Cells, streaming sources, world data activation in budgeted, time-sliced batches with bulk registration.

contracts.name: Render graph
contracts.summary: Pass/resource declaration, queues, history resources, readback, dynamic GPU-generated work nodes; barrier output mapped or elided on implicit-sync backends.

contracts.name: Shader interface & interop
contracts.summary: Shader modules, permutations and budgets, binding layouts generated per binding tier, interop headers, neural/tensor intrinsics tier; neural/tensor intrinsics are an optional tier with a mandatory standalone-dispatch fallback through C-MLGPU.

contracts.name: Material interface
contracts.summary: Material parameters, shading model inputs, material domains; raster-stage program (mask, world-position offset, displacement) and visibility-buffer/deferred resolve entry points.

contracts.name: Render scene & render features
contracts.summary: Render features and views, render-scene data streams extracted as change-tracked deltas (no per-object proxy mirror; CPU cost O(changes)), feature registration with minimum GPU tier, non-mesh primitive kinds; GPU-deformation flags and a cache-invalidation channel (pages, surface caches, BLAS updates); one persistent instance scene (C-INSTANCES); features consume it and never mirror it.

contracts.name: Temporal data
contracts.summary: Motion vectors, jitter, history validity, reactive/transparency masks, resolution scaling; motion-vector obligations for every moving/animated surface; UI/HUD separation for frame generation; depth+motion submission for XR spacewarp; denoiser signal submission (signal class, hit distance, sample count, guide buffers from C-SCENETEX) with per-signal and joint ray-reconstruction modes.

contracts.name: Render-scene ray tracing
contracts.summary: Render-side binding over C-RTAS: TLAS population from C-INSTANCES/C-RSCENE, hit/material binding, RT LOD, update policy.

contracts.name: Text layout & glyphs
contracts.summary: Shaped glyph runs, font fallback, glyph atlas/curve data; runs carry BCP-47 language/script; locale-aware line breaking.

contracts.name: 2D draw lists
contracts.summary: Batched 2D/vector/text draw submission used by UI, 2D games, debug overlays.

contracts.name: Physics world & scene queries
contracts.summary: Bodies, shapes, queries (handle-addressed, batched), contact events with budgets, stepping phases, batch add/remove O(batch), snapshot/restore/resimulate participation, collider history for rewind; world instances and local simulation spaces; conformance: restore + resimulate N ticks reproduces the state hash at the declared determinism level; backends (in-house 2D, in-house 3D, or middleware behind the integration layer PHY.ARCH.middleware-layer) implement it; every configuration that requires it contains one.

contracts.name: Animation pose output
contracts.summary: Pose output and control input (parameters, action/montage requests, instance lifetime), root motion, animation events, pose history for rewind, network-sync hooks, physics/render hand-off; trajectory/desired-motion input and root-motion delta output.

contracts.name: Audio emitters & events
contracts.summary: Emitter/listener data (multiple listeners), event triggering, parameters, busses, the sample-accurate audio clock exposed to gameplay.

contracts.name: Input actions
contracts.summary: Action definitions and values, tick-stamped input-command frames and their serialization (all targets incl. server); device binding contexts are client-side.

contracts.name: Netcode model & authority policy
contracts.summary: Netcode model per game type, authority model, net tick and time policy, compatibility window and handshake policy.

contracts.name: Platform services
contracts.summary: Identity tokens, entitlements & commerce, privileges, social graph, achievements, leaderboards, cloud save, region/age policy; platform-user handle and sign-in/user-change events on every platform.

contracts.name: Localized strings
contracts.summary: String IDs, formatting, locale switching.

contracts.name: UI widgets & binding
contracts.summary: Widget model, data binding, focus, layout; bindings resolved at load time and driven by change notification; per-local-player UI roots and focus owners; world-to-view projection for in-world UI; marker-source interface for the map service (implemented by gameplay marker registries).

contracts.name: Navigation queries
contracts.summary: Path requests, navmesh/grid queries, dynamic obstacles; batched path/query requests; nav produces path corridors and steering intents and never moves bodies.

contracts.name: Gameplay framework extension
contracts.summary: Game module entry points, rules/session state, data-oriented control binding (input source or AI → controlled entity), scheduled gameplay systems, extension hooks.

contracts.name: Script bindings
contracts.summary: Binding generation, sandbox limits, script lifecycle; execution on task-graph workers via per-worker VMs/isolates; world mutation only through deferred command buffers; weak handles to engine objects; script-authored systems declare access sets and are scheduled through C-FRAME.

contracts.name: Save games
contracts.summary: Save participation, versioned save records, async save/load; persisted player-settings store per scope, populating the C-CFG user layer.

contracts.name: Cook-step processors
contracts.summary: Processor inputs, cache keys, determinism class (bit-exact / tolerance / pinned-artifact), platform variants, world-scope steps, per-asset on-demand invocation, validation hooks; interactive, editor-invoked geometry operations (boolean/remesh/UV) for blockout.

contracts.name: Editor commands & tool extension
contracts.summary: Serializable, diff-based commands and transactions, undo/redo scopes (world, asset editor, PIE exclusion), selection, tool registration; journal feed for recovery and multi-user; cross-process transactions.

contracts.name: Graph authoring & compilation
contracts.summary: Node/pin model, validation, compilation hooks for domain graphs.

contracts.name: Build description
contracts.summary: Targets, configurations, toolchains, codegen steps.

contracts.name: Release packages & patches
contracts.summary: Package manifests, patch/DLC chunks, version compatibility.

contracts.name: Architecture, layering & profiles
contracts.summary: Layer rules, contract registry, configuration profiles, conventions; every query contract declares its batch granularity.

contracts.name: ADR & fitness functions
contracts.summary: ADR template incl. revisit conditions; automated architectural checks.

contracts.name: Evidence grading
contracts.summary: Source tiers, maturity classes, claim standards.

contracts.name: Agent coordination protocol
contracts.summary: Ownership ledger with access classes; write sets by module convention (src/<skill-id>/, tools/<skill-id>/; tests owned by the test-owning skill); shared-file protocol; contributor semantics (review + change request, never direct writes); change requests; integration order and milestones; human-gate tasks; failure triage; per-change provenance; critic gates with calibration and independent adjudication; access classes per skill (public | nda:<holder>); NDA work routed only to cleared agents; test write sets: tests/unit/<skill-id>/ implementer-owned; tests/acceptance/<contract-id>/ owned by the contract's oracle_author, read-only (oracle-ro) for implementers; lock leases and hand-off records (ARCH.ORG.agent-continuity); work-package format for delegated planning; model lineage recorded per change.

contracts.name: Test & validation definition of done
contracts.summary: Required test kinds per skill, test determinism, coverage & mutation thresholds, the evidence bundle an implementer hands to S3/S4 critics, oracle independence, conformance suites owned by contract owners with consumer-driven additions; a provider change merges only when the contract's conformance suite, including consumer-contributed cases, passes.

contracts.name: API stability & deprecation
contracts.summary: Public vs internal APIs, versioning, deprecation windows, upgraders.

contracts.name: Trust boundaries
contracts.summary: Untrusted inputs list, validation obligations, sandbox rules.

contracts.name: Accessibility requirements
contracts.summary: Mapped guideline requirements per player-facing feature.

contracts.name: Bootstrap base
contracts.summary: Raw page allocator, raw log/assert/abort sink, monotonic clock, raw thread primitives and late-bound hook tables that higher layers install (allocator, log sink, assert handler, crash annotator). Depends on nothing.

contracts.name: Ownership & retirement
contracts.summary: Engine-wide ownership and cross-thread reference rules; deferred-destruction/retirement service keyed to completion tokens (task completion, frames in flight, GPU fences).

contracts.name: Engine IPC
contracts.summary: Process model and IPC/RPC transport for editor↔runtime, tool workers, crash handler, profiler and script debugger; dev-only port security.

contracts.name: Scalability & governor
contracts.summary: Device-profile knobs, scalability cvars, budget query/report API, actuator registration and governor control signals.

contracts.name: Cross-subsystem data channels
contracts.summary: Versioned snapshots, double/triple-buffered hand-off, mailboxes and multi-rate resampling between subsystems; producer/consumer declared per channel. The default for runtime data flow; global barriers need an ADR.

contracts.name: Present timeline
contracts.summary: Present timeline and display-time prediction, latency markers, interposed presenters (frame generation, XR compositor), GPU-frame-complete and present-feedback sink implemented by the RHI (dependency inversion); shipping-grade GPU-frame-time and present-feedback signals that do not depend on C-INSTR.

contracts.name: Frame-state snapshot & resimulation
contracts.summary: Snapshot/restore, resimulate N ticks, history ring, per-participant cost declaration.

contracts.name: Replay container & streams
contracts.summary: Replay container, timeline, stream registration (input, replication, visual log, animation debug, external/nondeterministic inputs) and cross-build versioning.

contracts.name: Views & view arbitration
contracts.summary: View registry: view sources (gameplay camera, cinematic, editor, photo mode, XR pose) with priority/blend stack and shake/FOV channels, per-local-player views, view origin for LWC rebasing; derived listener and streaming-source signals for sinks.

contracts.name: Significance & simulation tiers
contracts.summary: Per-entity significance, simulation tier and update budget, computed once from views/players (all players on a server) and consumed by each domain's LOD policy; significance/relevancy computed over a spatial bucketing (C-SPATIAL index) with declared cost per player; tier-transition protocol: per-domain promote/demote handlers, state hand-off records, spawn-in validity (depenetration, grounding), hysteresis.

contracts.name: Environment queries
contracts.summary: Environment query service: ground height/surface type, water surface/volume (height, velocity, depth, body id), wind field, weather parameters, deformation deltas; implemented by terrain, water, atmosphere and voxel providers; headless-capable; queries submitted as batched streams per phase; provider bound per region/cell at activation (no per-query dispatch across providers).

contracts.name: GPU feature tiers
contracts.summary: Named GPU feature tiers (binding model, pipeline-state model, queue topology, mesh/RT/tensor support, memory model) and the API baseline each tier maps to; render features declare the minimum tier they need.

contracts.name: Instance scene
contracts.summary: Persistent instance/primitive handles, batched add/remove/update with delta upload (cost O(changes)), instance data layout shared with the ray-tracing instance builder; served by both CPU and GPU submission paths.

contracts.name: Geometry LOD & page residency
contracts.summary: Cluster/LOD selection and page residency for raster, shadow and ray-tracing consumers.

contracts.name: Texture residency & virtual texturing
contracts.summary: Texture residency requests, VT page tables/feedback and allocation for terrain, materials and runtime-composited textures.

contracts.name: Direct lighting sampling
contracts.summary: Light lists (clustered or stochastic), shadow lookups, light units, many-light sampling API for any shading point incl. translucency, volumes and particles.

contracts.name: Indirect lighting sampling
contracts.summary: Indirect diffuse/specular sampling for any shading point (incl. translucent and volumetric), probes, sky/environment lighting.

contracts.name: Atmosphere & participating media
contracts.summary: Aerial perspective, froxel/local media volumes, cloud shadows, weather-driven global material parameters; media sampling and injection only; sun/sky lighting inputs travel through C-LIGHTENV; inject-media and sample-media API for the single media integrator.

contracts.name: Video surfaces
contracts.summary: Video playback sessions, surfaces as textures, timing against the audio clock.

contracts.name: Input devices & haptics
contracts.summary: Device enumeration, raw state and events with timestamps, device↔platform-user pairing, haptic, trigger-effect and LED output, virtual device injection for automation.

contracts.name: Network links & channels
contracts.summary: Sessions, channels, reliability/ordering classes, send budgets, link statistics, connection events; used by replication, voice, rollback input exchange and telemetry streams; platform-SDK transports (Steam/EOS/console relays) register as backends implemented by platform-services and online-services-liveops.

contracts.name: Replication
contracts.summary: Replicated state declaration, relevancy hooks, RPCs, net IDs, batch registration, replay and spectator streams; producers mark dirty state; no per-connection full-state comparison; per-faction visibility registers as a relevancy filter through the relevancy hooks (basis of XC.SEC.info-hiding).

contracts.name: Prediction & rollback
contracts.summary: Predicted/rollback-able state registration, tick-stamped input history, resimulation hooks, rewind queries, cosmetic-effect suppression during resim.

contracts.name: Character movement
contracts.summary: Movement modes, move requests, resimulatable move API, root-motion hand-off.

contracts.name: Gameplay data
contracts.summary: Data tables, curve assets, tuning assets with overrides, live override layer; gameplay tag registry and tag queries; the live override layer is a sink of the single C-LIVE remote-config payload (precedence in CORE.LIFE.config).

contracts.name: Dialogue lines & narrative state
contracts.summary: Line records (speaker, text per locale, VO per locale, timing, lip-sync data), conditions, playback requests, narrative fact store; runtime line records (provenance = generated, transient ID, locale, moderation verdict, TTS/lip-sync-at-runtime flags, caption obligations).

contracts.name: AI decision-provider extension point
contracts.summary: Optional decision providers (learned policies, LLM agents) with budget, timeout, moderation and authored fallback; conversational memory persisted through C-SAVE with retention and PII limits; generated text routed through localization; provider outputs enter simulation only as recorded external inputs (C-REPLAY external stream; replicated from authority); providers are never re-invoked on resimulate.

contracts.name: Accessibility runtime
contracts.summary: Caption/subtitle submission, screen-reader announcements and accessibility-tree ingestion, TTS/STT, accessibility settings and change events; caption sources: dialogue, audio-event captions, sequencer; settings read through a snapshot like C-CFG; accessibility settings are C-CFG settings entries.

contracts.name: Developer UI
contracts.summary: Immediate-mode developer UI and debug menus available in development builds on every target.

contracts.name: Editor host
contracts.summary: Asset-editor host (panel embedding of preview worlds from C-EDVIEW), thumbnail caching, inspector customization, shared curve/timeline widgets; every asset editor registers a diff/merge provider (C-VCS).

contracts.name: Online & live-ops services
contracts.summary: Sessions/matchmaking tickets, remote config, events/experiments, chat sessions, moderation, generative/inference service calls with quotas, trusted time, service emulation; cross-platform parties and presence; content-key delivery for pre-loaded and embargoed content.

contracts.name: XR views
contracts.summary: View poses, projections, foveation maps, compositor layers and spacewarp depth/motion submission.

contracts.name: GPU inference
contracts.summary: Inference as a render-graph pass under async-compute and budget scheduling; weights for in-shader networks.

contracts.name: External requirements register
contracts.summary: Register of external requirements per program (console cert, Steam Deck Verified, store review, law) each mapped to an owning capability; owners must satisfy their entries; the shared register is public: id, owner capability and a sanitized paraphrase; holder-specific TRC text lives only in per-holder confidential partitions under PLAT.CON.confidential-slots and is never published through the shared register.

contracts.name: Performance findings protocol
contracts.summary: Finding format (hypothesis, capture, attribution, expected gain), routing as a change request to the owning skill, time-boxed territory loans recorded in the ledger.

contracts.name: Benchmark registration
contracts.summary: Benchmark registration, metric schema, C-BUDGET line reference, warm-up and variance rules, required hardware tier, replay-driven runs; runs through the in-process runner in OBS.LOG.bench-runtime, present in every configuration; gates run on the profile build configuration.

contracts.name: Engine roadmap & intake
contracts.summary: Roadmap priorities consumed by work decomposition, intake/triage SLAs, release-note obligations.

contracts.name: Release model
contracts.summary: Branch model, release trains, version identifiers, client/server/content compatibility keys, LTS and hotfix streams.

contracts.name: Runtime governor
contracts.summary: Governor control inputs from shipping-grade signals (GPU frame time, present feedback, pool pressure, thermal/power) independent of C-INSTR; actuator commands through C-SCALE; decision log.

contracts.name: Per-view scene textures
contracts.summary: Named per-view render-graph resources and their producer phases: depth, HZB, visibility IDs, surface-attribute decode (visibility buffer and deferred), velocity, scene color, denoiser/upscaler guide buffers; variants per shading path and tier.

contracts.name: Color, exposure & display state
contracts.summary: Working color space, per-view exposure and pre-exposure with its frame latency, output display descriptor (SDR/HDR, transfer function, paper white, peak luminance, calibration), UI/video composition rules.

contracts.name: Per-frame lighting environment
contracts.summary: Per-view environment block published in an early declared phase: sun/moon direction and illuminance after atmospheric transmittance, sky irradiance, cloud-shadow and fog resources, weather material scalars. Implemented by atmosphere-weather where present; a static default otherwise.

contracts.name: Translucent & decal submission
contracts.summary: Translucent surface submission (sort keys, OIT tier, composition pass before/after DOF and upscale), refraction/distortion buffer, decal submission.

contracts.name: Acceleration structures & ray queries
contracts.summary: Acceleration-structure build/refit/compaction, instance and geometry inputs, ray-query API with hardware and software backends; independent of the render scene.

contracts.name: Procedural generation requests
contracts.summary: Seeded, deterministic generation requests per cell/chunk/level, headless-capable; results as entity/instance batches.

contracts.name: Vehicle control & telemetry
contracts.summary: Control inputs (throttle, brake, steer, collective…), seat/occupant attachment points, telemetry stream (RPM, load, slip, contacts), force-feedback torque source, simulation-tier hand-off (physics ↔ kinematic ↔ abstract).

contracts.name: Target-platform tool modules
contracts.summary: Per-target-platform tool modules loaded by editor, cooker and packager: cook format variants, shader backend compiler hook, packager, deploy/launch/debug on device.

contracts.name: Network session
contracts.summary: Session lifecycle events (connect, join-ready, spawn, reconnect, travel, disconnect with reason), host mode, baseline hand-off, auth results.

contracts.name: Server host lifecycle
contracts.summary: Host lifecycle (allocate, ready, health, drain, shutdown), instance metadata, per-connection budgets and overload state, authenticated admin command surface.

contracts.name: Multi-server authority
contracts.summary: Region/cell → server ownership map, entity migration protocol, authority transfer, cross-boundary relevancy, cross-server messages.

contracts.name: Server persistence & transactions
contracts.summary: Persistent records with leases and write-behind, idempotent transactions, schema migration hooks.

contracts.name: Viewport tool modes
contracts.summary: Viewport tool modes, brush/stroke input and world raycast picking, gizmo/manipulator extension, viewport overlays, 2D/ortho mode, preview-world creation.

contracts.name: Version control
contracts.summary: Workspace/changelist model, status and lock queries, checkout-on-write hook, semantic diff/merge provider registration, sparse-sync payload requests, partner-scoped access.

contracts.name: Runtime edit session
contracts.summary: In-game creation sessions: serializable commands (schema shared with C-EDCMD per ED.ARCH.transactions), undo, selection, permissions and per-creation budgets, publish/version; runtime graph authoring and compilation (XC.EXT.runtime-graphs; node/pin schema shared with C-GRAPH); command schema from C-CMD.

contracts.name: Runtime automation & introspection
contracts.summary: Structured command/query/observe protocol, discovery of exposed debug state and controls, frame stepping, capture triggers, capability negotiation, versioned schema from C-REFL, dev-only authentication; compiled out of shipping builds.

contracts.name: Integrity validation hooks
contracts.summary: Validator registration per authoritative action (movement deltas, hits, economy), anomaly-signal sink, rate-limit policy, client anti-cheat middleware boundary, attestation results.

contracts.name: Test host
contracts.summary: Test registration, runner, fixtures, fault-point registry, result reporting; present in development and test builds of every configuration.

contracts.name: Crypto & signed artifacts
contracts.summary: Crypto primitives and CSPRNG, signature envelope, trust roots, rotation/revocation, version floors (anti-rollback), algorithm agility.

contracts.name: Abilities, effects & attributes
contracts.summary: Ability activation, effects, attributes, gameplay messages, hit results; marker registry (POIs) published to C-UI marker sources.

contracts.name: Crowds & mass agents
contracts.summary: Agent spawn/despawn, batched queries, LOD and tier hooks, traffic promotion requests.

contracts.name: Sequences
contracts.summary: Sequence playback, actor binding, event/track callbacks, skip and blend policy.

contracts.name: AI agents
contracts.summary: Brain assignment (behavior/state trees, utility, HTN), perception stimulus sources, smart-object claim/release, environment query service; learned/LLM providers plug in through C-AIAGENT; per-faction visibility and explored-state queries; the visibility field is published to fog rendering and maps through a declared C-FLOW channel; tactical/environment queries (EQS class), not world queries (C-ENV).

contracts.name: Command & transaction core
contracts.summary: Serializable diff-based commands, apply/invert, transaction batching, journal and merge hooks; the schema shared by the editor (C-EDCMD) and runtime edit sessions (C-EDIT).
